SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002463
DOCKET NO. F00668424
PLAINTIFF – MCLP ASSET COMPANY, INC
DEFENDANTS- JOSEPH W. SULLIVAN; MR./MRS. JOSEPH W. SULLIVAN, SPOUSE OF JOSEPH W. SULLIVAN; RON MEEKS; AHS HOSPITAL CORP; THE CARDIOVASCULAR CARE GROUP, P.C.; JUNIKU HOME RENOVATIONS LLC; LIBERTY NY RESTORATION INC.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 2nd DAY OF December 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of CRANFORD, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 14 BLOCK 245
LOT 14 BLOCK 245
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
203 COLUMBIA AVENUE CRANFORD, NJ 07016
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: DIMENSIONS (APPROX.): 5,000 SF
NEAREST CROSS STREET: Columbia Av (approximately 80 ft/24 m)
ESTIMATED UPSET BID AMOUNT: $431,OOO.OO, in addition to lawful interest accruing daily at the rate allowed by law, up to and including the actual day of sale plus any additional Sheriff fees, costs, and/or commission, and/or any additional sums as ordered by the court. Bid amount is subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances and/or adjournment.
PROPERTY OCCUPANCY: The property is currently reported to be owner occupied.
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description is annexed to that certain mortgage recorded in the Office of the Register/Clerk of Union County in Book 9843, Page 227, and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Union County.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior COU1t Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any *
"THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE
WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION"
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $358,034.99 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: October 28, 2026
